environment.description: Application deployed in an EKS pod (distroless base image with wkhtmltopdf added as a static binary). Pod security context specifies a custom seccomp profile loaded via the node's /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/report-svc.json. The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode with a whitelist of 87 syscalls required for wkhtmltopdf rendering. Critically, the profile BLOCKS execve/execveat for any binary path NOT matching /usr/local/bin/wkhtmltopdf (using SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ on the first argument's resolved path via audit-assisted BPF). Additionally, the pod runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with an emptyDir volume mounted at /tmp and /var/reports only. The container also has NET_RAW and SYS_PTRACE capabilities explicitly dropped, and a NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the cluster DNS (kube-dns on port 53/UDP) and an internal S3 VPC endpoint on port 443 — no other outbound connectivity is permitted.

config.seccomp_mode: SCMP_ACT_ERRNO whitelist, execve restricted to /usr/local/bin/wkhtmltopdf only
